slides.id: A study loop students can trust
slides.titleAttr: A study loop students can trust
slides.notes: 0:45. The user is a CSIT6000V student. The job is to keep up with dense material, practise at assignment scale, and know what help is allowed. The pain is that a fluent answer is not a checkable answer. We chose the task-oriented direction: measure the study loop against hosted assistants, not system efficiency.

slides.id: A typed loop, not a prompt
slides.titleAttr: A typed loop, not a prompt
slides.notes: 0:40. Perception is the message, history, document context, and tool results. Planning is model-driven inside the agent node, constrained by a closed tool set. Execution validates arguments and streams results. Reflection is tool-mediated: verify_span, same-model retries, abstain when evidence is missing.

slides.id: A source is not a citation until the span passes
slides.titleAttr: A source is not a citation until the span passes
displayTexts: A source is not a citation until the span
slides.titleDisplay: A source is not a citation until the span
slides.notes: 0:30. The verifier normalizes whitespace and case, requires the quoted span to occur on the cited page, allows one repair round, and otherwise abstains. Pass becomes a citation; fail goes back to repair or abstention. Persisting the verified layer is the next step.

slides.id: Tutorials are the hard slice
slides.titleAttr: Tutorials are the hard slice
slides.notes: 0:35. Tutorial questions retrieve worse than concept, mechanism or assignment questions. The likely cause is that tutorial pages bundle several sub-tasks into one page. Dual-granularity chunking raised hit@5 but not significantly, at 2.7 times the index cost, so we kept the page-first rule and logged it.
slides.visibleText: 16 / Failure & Limits Tutorials are the hard slice . Page-level nDCG@5, 51 test questions. tutorial 0.617 mechanism 0.875 assignment 0.909 concept 0.912 Tutorial pages bundle several sub-tasks. Tutorial 4 Verified citations: next TACC execution: next Instructor/TA UI: partial Scope: one course Lesson Dual granularity raised hit@5 0.882 to 0.941; nDCG interval crossed zero; index cost 2.7×. 17 / 20

slides.id: Verifiability is a system property
slides.titleAttr: Verifiability is a system property
slides.notes: 0:30. The page is the retrieval unit, the policy is code, and the evaluation separates grounding from grading. The student loop is end-to-end. The operator console, verifier persistence, TACC execution, and multi-course support are the next surfaces.
